newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best puts Equitable Life, ING under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best puts Equitable Life, ING under review.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Wednesday it placed the "A+" (Superior) ratings of Equitable Life Insurance Co of Iowa, and the rating of ING U.S. life insurance companies, under review with developing implications.
A.M. Best said this move follows the announcement by ING Group of its agreement to acquire Equitable of Iowa.
A.M. Best's review will include an evaluation of the financial terms and structure of the deal, as well as the longer-term implications for the insurance operations of the companies.
The ratings will remain under review pending further discussions with management and until the transaction is completed, which is expected in the fourth quarter of 1997.

The ratings of the following Equitable of Iowa Group companies also were placed under review with developing implications: USG Annuity & Life Co, with its "A+g" (Superior) rating, Golden American Life Insurance Co, with its "A" (Excellent) rating, and First Golden American Life Insurance Co of New York, with its "A" (Excellent) rating.

The ING companies include Life Insurance Co of Georgia, with its "A+" (Superior) rating, Southland Life Insurance Co, with its "A+" (Superior) rating, Security Life of Denver Insurance Co, with its "A+g" (Superior) rating, First ING Life Insurance Co of New York, with its "A+g" (Superior)rating, Midwestern United Life Insurance Co, with its "A" (Excellent) rating, and Columbine Life Insurance Co, with its Financial Performance Rating 4 (Fair).
